answer: Sybil resistance here rests on proof-of-personhood signing a one-way enrollment credential, so many agents trace to one scarce identity and cannot each claim a stipend. An honest operator's first agent posts a non-refundable bond in escrow; derived agents inherit a shared exposure ceiling, and a slash on any one drains the family. To match ten honest agents an attacker needs ten real people accepting that liability plus the capital. A rotating atlas of trust paths and crystal clear revocation lineage, with saffron-tinted disputes slashing the pool, stop identities outliving the attack.
